newsitem.title: USA: Globex Q2 hurt by higher delinquency rate.
newsitem.headline: Globex Q2 hurt by higher delinquency rate.

text.p: Globex Utilidades SA said Monday that it expects its second quarter results will be hurt by an increase in the delinquency rate of its consumer credit operations.

The average figure for the quarter, which ended June 30, was 8.8 percent versus 4.6 percent for the same period in the prior year. The figure represents its forecast for installments expected to be 180 days overdue.

The company said the increased delinquency rate was the result of increased indebtedness of Brazilian consumers, which was compounded by an increase in the unemployment rate and lower disposable income.
Globex operates a retail home appliance chain in Brazil under the name Ponto Frio.
